issues.on_page: Transfers in (out) 107,443 (Total Governmental Funds, under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES)); fund columns p6-7: General 116,348, Street 27,276, Other 18,452 in; Sinking (51,424), Library Memorial (3,209) out
issues.issue: Correct section (other financing) and the amount is the printed Total-column net. It is recorded as transfers_in with transfers_out null, so the governmental gross flows (162,076 in, 54,633 out) are visible only in the detail. The net equals the business-type transfers_net -107,443, so the roll-forward is consistent. Assumption: a printed net is stored in transfers_in.
